name: Qlippoth Subdomain
body:
Qlippoth are a race of chaotic evil outsiders.

Associated Domain(s): Chaos, Evil.

Replacement Power: The following power replaces the chaos blade power of the Chaos domain or the scythe of evil power of the Evil domain.

Horrific Appearance (Su)

At 8th level, as a standard action, you can present yourself to assault the senses of one living creature within 30 feet. The victim of this attack is frightened for a number of rounds equal to ½ your cleric level. A successful Will saving throw (DC = 10 + ½ your cleric level + your Wisdom bonus) negates the effect. This ability is a mind-affecting gaze attack. You can use this ability once per day at 8th level, and an additional time per day for every 4 levels beyond 8th.

Replacement Domain Spells: 3rd—call the void, 6th—contact entity VI, 7th—weird.
